categories.main_business_segments: Hainan Airport Infrastructure Co., Ltd. operates primarily in airport management, duty-free and commercial businesses, real estate development and sales, property management, and hotel and catering services. The airport management segment includes both aeronautical and non-aeronautical services such as landing, parking, passenger services, security, retail, advertising, cargo, and office leasing. The duty-free and commercial segment involves duty-free store operations and commercial real estate leasing. Real estate includes development projects and property sales, while property management covers management of various property types. Other businesses include hotel operations and flight simulation training services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced airport operation technologies including digital transformation with big data and AI for smart airport construction and management, such as intelligent gate allocation, flight delay prediction, and smart security checks. It employs modern construction techniques for airport expansions and terminal buildings, focusing on zero-carbon terminals and smart infrastructure. The flight simulation training uses advanced simulators for pilot and crew training. Real estate development incorporates modern construction and project management methods aligned with sustainable development goals.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include airlines, passengers, cargo operators, duty-free retailers, commercial tenants, real estate buyers, and property management clients. The airport services cater to domestic and international travelers, airlines, and cargo businesses. Duty-free and commercial operations serve tourists and local consumers, especially leveraging the Hainan Free Trade Port policies. Real estate customers include residential, commercial, and industrial buyers and tenants. The flight training business serves aviation professionals and related personnel.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China, with a focus on Hainan Province, including major airports such as Sanya Phoenix International Airport and Haikou Meilan International Airport. It also manages and holds stakes in airports in other Chinese cities including Anqing, Tangshan, Weifang, Yingkou, Manzhouli, Yichang, Dongying, Songyuan, and Sansha. Real estate and commercial projects are mainly concentrated in Hainan but also extend to other provinces such as Liaoning, Heilongjiang, Sichuan, and Hubei.
categories.supply_chain_position: Hainan Airport Infrastructure Co., Ltd. operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the aviation and real estate supply chains. It manages airport operations (midstream), provides commercial and duty-free retail spaces (downstream), develops and sells real estate (downstream), and offers property management and hotel services (downstream). It also engages in flight training services supporting the aviation industry.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic priorities include deepening reform and technological innovation to build a world-class airport operation group. It focuses on digital transformation using AI and big data for smart airport management, zero-carbon terminal construction, and enhancing safety technologies. It aims to expand international routes, develop the low-altitude economy and general aviation, and promote integration of airport operations with commercial, real estate, and logistics sectors. The company also emphasizes cultivating a professional, modern, and market-oriented enterprise structure aligned with Hainan Free Trade Port development.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated through multiple streams: airport management fees including aeronautical and non-aeronautical services; rental income from duty-free and commercial properties; sales and leasing income from real estate projects; property management fees; hotel operations revenue; and fees from flight simulation training services. The company also earns investment income from equity stakes and financial assets.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading state-owned airport infrastructure operator in Hainan and holds a significant position in the regional airport management market. It competes with other airport operators in China, especially in the South China aviation market, and faces competition in real estate and property management sectors. Its unique positioning is strengthened by its integration with the Hainan Free Trade Port policies and its diversified business model spanning airports, duty-free retail, real estate, and services.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 4.37 billion, a decrease of 35.4% from the previous year, and a net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 458.5 million, down 51.88%. Total assets stood at about RMB 53.7 billion with net assets of RMB 23.5 billion. The company experienced a decline in revenue mainly due to reduced real estate sales but continues to invest in airport expansions and new projects. It maintains a stable financial scale with ongoing growth potential linked to Hainan Free Trade Port development.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its strategic location within the Hainan Free Trade Port, leveraging policy advantages such as duty-free shopping and international aviation hubs. It offers integrated airport services combined with commercial, real estate, and property management operations, creating a synergistic ecosystem. Its focus on smart, green, and digital airport infrastructure, along with diversified business lines including flight training and hotel services, differentiates it from competitors. The company also highlights its professional management capabilities and strong brand reputation in the region.
